title: Black Widow night fighters redeployed to patrol around Roswell

tellings.quote: what I found out was that we had a night fighter during World War II called the Black Widow.

plain: In 1947, the story goes, the military sent the Black Widow, a night fighter plane from World War II, to patrol the skies around Roswell, New Mexico. The researcher John Brandenburg tells it as something he found out himself, and he credits a set of documents he calls Cosmic Awakening. If true, it would mean the military was watching the night sky over Roswell closely that year.
